compiled_state.title: Edit ci-python-skills.yml: add cache: 'pip' and install from requirements.lock
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD3: CI install pipeline uses actions/setup-python with cache: 'pip' against a checked-in lockfile so cold-runner pip install does not regress CI run duration.

## Implementation
Edit .github/workflows/ci-python-skills.yml to:

1. Add `cache: 'pip'` to the `actions/setup-python@v5` step:
   ```yaml
   - name: Set up Python
     uses: actions/setup-python@v5
     with:
       python-version: '3.13'
       cache: 'pip'
       cache-dependency-path: plugins/dso/scripts/requirements.lock
   ```

2. Change the "Install Python dependencies" step to install from requirements.lock:
   ```yaml
   - name: Install Python dependencies
     run: pip install -r plugins/dso/scripts/requirements.lock && pip install pytest
   ```
   
   OR install the package in editable mode (which installs litellm and deps from lockfile):
   ```yaml
   - name: Install Python dependencies
     run: pip install -r plugins/dso/scripts/requirements.lock -e plugins/dso/scripts/ && pip install pytest
   ```
   
   NOTE: The run-python-tests.sh script already does `pip install -e` for the package. The CI step just needs to pre-install from the lockfile so the cache is populated. Use the approach that avoids double-installation.
   
   Best approach: Only install from lockfile in CI; let run-python-tests.sh handle the editable install as it already does.
   
   Final CI step:
   ```yaml
   - name: Install Python dependencies  
     run: pip install -r plugins/dso/scripts/requirements.lock
   ```

3. The setup-python cache: 'pip' will cache based on the lockfile hash, so cold runners restore from cache on subsequent runs.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/skills/run-python-tests.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] ci-python-skills.yml setup-python step has cache: 'pip'
  Verify: grep -q "cache: 'pip'" .github/workflows/ci-python-skills.yml
- [ ] ci-python-skills.yml references requirements.lock
  Verify: grep -q "requirements.lock" .github/workflows/ci-python-skills.yml
- [ ] T1 RED test now passes (GREEN)
  Verify: python3 -m pytest tests/skills/test_ci_workflow_pip_cache.py::test_ci_python_skills_uses_pip_cache_and_lockfile -v 2>&1 | grep -q "PASSED"

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet->opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
